fields.v: Limitations: preliminary study; constructs inferred by one author; validation procedures not audited. Gaps: benchmarks rarely define target constructs; missing evidence on content validity, factor structure, predictive relationships and score stability; lack of standardized task attributes undermines comparability; need code-quality metrics (static analysis vs LLM judges) and benchmarks of long-term effects of agent use (e.g. ISO/IEC 25010); planned empirical assessment of the factor structure of coding-ability constructs and of task description quality
